Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in statistics block caused task failure despite successful sheet structure setup.
The run failed during `test_derived_values_and_stats` in `test_outputs.py`. While `EXPECTED_NET` metrics passed, the statistics block (rows 46-47, columns H-L) returned `#NAME?` errors instead of the expected float values. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 failed with messages like 'H46: expected -1.5187952898550745, got #NAME?'. This indicates a syntax error in the Excel formulas or the use of unsupported functions in the generated workbook.
